title: Adoption tax credit - federal framework
facts: Federal tax law provides an adoption credit for qualifying adoption expenses subject to annual limits, income phaseouts and eligibility rules.
The applicable dollar maximum changes by tax year and should be taken from the dated tax record rather than treated as permanent.
Special timing rules apply to when expenses can be claimed, and the rules differ for domestic and foreign adoptions.
Expenses reimbursed by an employer or another source generally cannot also be used for the credit to the extent prohibited by federal tax rules.
